FULL TEXT:
DEPARTMENT OF SANSKRIT
PANJAB UNIVERSITY, CHANDIGARH- 160014 (INDIA)
Ref. No. D-SKT/24/14 Dated: 9/1/2024
APPLICATION FOR THE POST OF GUEST FACULTY
Applications are invited from suitable candidates for the post of Guest Faculty (specialization in
Literature and Literary Criticism) for Even Semester, January, 2024 onwards.
Essential Qualifications
As per UGC & P.U Guidelines, in addition M.A in Sanskrit is must.
(i) Besides fulfilling the above qualification the candidate must have cleared the National
Eligibility Test (NET) conducted by UGC or must fulfill the other UGC regulations for
recruitment and appointment of Assistant Professor or equivalent positions in the
University/College/Institute.
(ii) Good Academic record as defined by concerned University with at least 55% marks
(50% marks in case of SC/ST/Physically Handicapped/Visually Handicapped) or an
equivalent grade in Masters degree level.
Selection Process
Eligible and shortlisted candidates will be called for interview in the office of the Chairperson, Deptt. of
Sanskrit, Arts Block-1, Panjab University, Chandigarh.
Last Date
Applications to be submitted latest by 18th January, 2024 upto 4.00 pm in the office of Deptt. of
Sanskrit, Arts Block-1, PU, Chandigarh
Affidavit
The shortlisted candidate will have to submit an affidavit of Rs. 10/- regarding
1. They are not employed elsewhere.
2. There are no criminal proceedings, charge-sheets, police cases, cases of moral misconduct or
court cases against them
The application form for the post of Guest Faculty (Assistant Professor) is available at website
http://jobs.puchd.ac.in/forms.php. The above assignment is on lecture basis with a token honorarium of
Rs.1500/- per lecture with an upper limit of Rs. 50,000/- per month. You are advised to visit the notice
board of department website : sanskrit.puchd.ac.in for any further update.
*Working hours for the appointee will be 9.00 a.m. to 5.00 p.m.
*No TA/DA shall be paid for attending the interview
sd/-
(V.K.Alankar)
Academic Incharge
